label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: The study explicitly requires centrally confirmed DSRCT with documented EWSR1-WT1 translocation. Histology and its defining molecular confirmation are both stated, so the explicit-diagnosis category is used.
cohort_reconciliation: Single phase II lurbinectedin/irinotecan cohort for locally advanced/metastatic disease in lines 2–4 after anthracycline-containing treatment. Eligibility includes recent standard-therapy intolerance as well as progression, whereas the narrative emphasizes progression.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Documented EWSR1-WT1 is a required diagnostic confirmation. No additional unrelated molecular gate is stated, and no individual assay is established here.
protocol_uncertainty: Age at least 15, one to three prior chemotherapy lines, disease state, prior-drug exclusions and clinical criteria remain applicable. External protocol and live slots are unverified.
quotes: Histological centrally confirmed diagnosis of DSRCT with the documented presence of EWSR1-WT1 translocation.
